name: middle-earth
description: The Lord of the Rings mods: middle-earth takes an issue or a pull request's review to committed and reviewed work (Elrond plans, the Fellowship builds in a worktree of its own, Galadriel's Mirror writes tests first, the Argonath prove and judge each change, the Black Gate reads review, Mount Doom clears what is done), while Andúril and the palantír, each useful alone, watch what the code does
